name: the Dungeons
note: The instanced raid dungeons (handlers/dungeons.go, entity/dungeons.go; claude-notes/dungeon-world-20261112.md): the disc's own zones of ten dungeons (Blackburrow, Runnyeye with Misty Thicket before its gate, Guk; since 2026-11-12 also the Tomb of Kings, Castle Felstar, Collonridge Cemetery, Vox's lair in Permafrost, Box Canyons, and Odus's Toxxulia's lair and the Warrens; since 2026-11-14 the Salt Mines, the Siloth's shaft with the drachnids below, and Crethley Manor, the necromancer lord's house and its graveyard), each where it stands on Tunaria; every raid, group or lone player that goes in fights in a copy of its own (an instance). The dungeons block is read by the server, never written into the file: each dungeon's key, name, the boxes its creatures stand in (the world's npcs rows inside them are its templates, tools/dungeons_20261112.py) and where a player sent in lands, facing the way in. The open edges are closed by cmd/worldedges' rocks (dungeons-edges.json), kept by -keep clear of every creature, entrance and each new dungeon's box (petitions 1808/1812: a rock over a landing or a tunnel is an invisible wall). Built by cmd/worldbuild from the operator's disc.
